items.text: The one loading process found for this table reads from a source that does not exist anywhere in this Oracle environment. The process is scheduled to run daily and has been since 2015, but whether it actually runs successfully, or fails silently every day against a missing source, is unconfirmed

This table holds only 5 rows, all created within the same half hour on 2017-01-18, and none has changed since. This is the complete, stable list of business scenarios Weis reports budgets against (Actual, Budgeted, Projected, Actual (approx), Preacquisition Sales)

A related, live table elsewhere in the warehouse carries a column referencing the same missing concept, confirming it is a real idea used elsewhere in the business, not a typo confined to one file. This does not resolve where the missing source table itself actually is

A changelog note in a later file export confirms QTY_SEMANTIC_DIM, read as the loader's missing qty_semantic source by name match, was decommissioned in 2014. Its own last change to this table was in 2017, a 3 year gap this note does not explain, but it does confirm the job's source has been gone for over a decade, not merely mistyped or recently dropped
No staging table has ever existed for this table, unlike almost every other reference table in this project; the loading process writes directly into the final table
This table has no record of who last updated each row, unlike every other reference table reviewed so far; only a record of who created it, the same value on all 5 rows
